'''Tek'lor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]], she was stationed at [[Dorn Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tek'lor appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Crew Skill Trade Vendor for Imperial players on Hoth.<ref name="TOR" />
